0:
Nymph! Nymph'! Hurry! Over here! Quick,
quick!
1: What?! What in the world is this about?!
3:
Yeah! Dragging us out here all of a
sudden... What are you even thinking?
4:
No ifs, ands or buts! The reason I brought
you here... is that!
5:
That? You mean... That's just a ramen
shop.
7:
But there's a table set up out front, and
a crowd's gathered... What's that about?
8:
Heh heh heh. That is a newly opened ramen
shop. And what's happening in front of it is
the grand-opening event...
10:
Wha-! Wh-who are you calling flat-chested?!
Who?!
11:
Not that kind of "peta"! Don't make such a
flat... I mean, such a cliched mistake! It's a
unit, a unit! Peta, the one above tera!
12:
It means the serving is that huge! ...Oh!
Here it comes now! Look! That's the
Peta-Size Ramen!
14:
Whoa! What is that?! I've never seen a bowl
that huge, it's like a bucket!
15:
Are you stupid?! There's no way anyone
could finish all that!
16:
Right. You can't finish it. No normal person
could ever finish it. But that's exactly
why...
17:
Whoever finishes it gets 5000 yen in cash!
But if you leave any, you have to pay 5000
yen for it instead!
20: Huh?! You're taking on that thing?!
22: No way I can! But you two could surely...
23: Don't ask the impossible, you idiot!
25:
If you can't eat that much, there's no way I
can! You really are an idiot!
26:
Stop calling me an idiot! Nobody said you
had to eat it alone!
29: Two people can eat it together?
30:
Normally, no. No, but... you two... should be
able to pull it off!
33:
...I really hope I'm wrong, but... you want us
to swap places partway through?
34:
Exactly! A ramen that's impossible for one
person can surely be eaten by two!
35:
And the way you two are right now, if I do a
good job of distracting the spectators
and the staff...
36:
Nobody'll ever notice you swapping
partway through! It's perfect! A perfect
plan!
37:
What's perfect about it?! It's total
cheating! You want us to be your
accomplices in that?
40:
Besides, we went through all that trouble
to catch my clone, and for something like
this...
41:
You'd set her loose just for a measly 5000
yen?! Unbelievable!
43:
Yeah, yeah! I'm happy to be set loose, but
I'm not going along with something like that!
44:
...Huh? Wait, you don't want to? Eat that
ramen, I mean.
53:
Please! I'm begging you! Help me out! Of
course you'll get a share! And besides...
56: If you help me out, I'll do anything you say!
62:
G-guess it can't be helped... I-if you're
going that far, I'll help you out!
64:
No...! You're not that kind of person at all!
You're not someone who'd say something
so cold!
66:
Yes! I know you'll help me when I'm in
trouble! You're that kind of sweet girl!
70:
F-fine, all right! I-if you're going that far,
I'll help you out!
71:
(...Heh heh heh. You fell for it, you fool!
With flattery this cheap...)
73: Don't say that, I'm begging you!
78:
Please please please please please! I'm
begging, begging, begging, begging you!
79: I told you no, didn't I?!
80:
Please please please please please please
please please please please please please
please please please PLEASE!
81:
Argh! Geez! Fine, all right! We just have to
do it, right?! Fine, we'll do it!
85:
Ohh... Ohhhhhhh! Th-thank you! Thank you!
Both of you!
86:
Now that prize money is guaranteed to roll
right into my hands~! Yaaaaay~!
88:
Okaaay! You there, little lady! Too ba~ad!
Challenge failed!
91: I... I can't eat another bite...
92:
Dammit... I even put on a weird dance to
grab everyone's attention so the two of
them could swap...
93:
Who'd have thought... even the two of them
together couldn't finish it... I didn't see
that coming...!
94:
Your plan was way too naive... Delta, maybe,
but for us, that thing's impossible even
two at a time...!
95:
Dammit... Should I have just had Astraea
take the challenge? I figured two were
better than one...
96:
So this is what being too clever for your
own good means...!
97:
No, never mind that! My 5000 yen~! What am I
supposed to do from tomorrow on~?!
99:
Honestly... you brought this on yourself...
...Hic...
